clue.text: Strict believer to 1-Down a mind reader
Raise capital for future partner, concealing money in the middle
Roosevelt's program, as expected: genuflect to Rev. Spooner
Sound equipment shredding spam
I heap our bananas high
Engine's fishtail cut off
What might drive a crazy person?!
Confiscation of submachine gun, brought back dry on the outside
Puzzle constructor to joke over center of square
Father follows every direction, for every periodical
Marx in a California city
Discussed academic official in reverse requirement
Chatterbox Japanese detective mixed hot rum
Make like a bat beginning to eat ground chocolate
Motley crew's leader comes into power, ousting Republican
Goddess who can never get to Point B?
Sunshine heard about from valley inhabitant?
River is almost an area for doctors' group?
Face viper, etc., in consternation
Organize lab gear for high school class
Paintings of a container in front of vessels
Queen's uncontrolled lust preceding one sign of adultery, perhaps?
Musical performers who deliver a little fire?
Categorize simple language, from start to finish, as "spoken"
Puzzle constructor's chicken dominating small state
Devise cooking utensil to hold head of lettuce
Prison agitation
Snake's associate in providing support?
Deny getting overtime? I try to reach an agreement
Dickens and Thackeray, e.g., enthralling 2 speakers at school
